title: Hopf Fibration Shader Context Pack
purpose: RepoScripter context repository for visualizing the Hopf fibration S³ → S² via stereographic projection, quaternion navigation, and GLSL fragment shaders. Encodes the mathematics, visual motifs, color systems, and camera paths needed to generate and extend Hopf fibration visualizations.
visual_motifs: linked circles threading through each other
rainbow longitude banding across torus shells
fiber threads as luminous glowing curves
fibers flowing toward infinity at the projection pole
techniques: Hopf map h: S³ → S² using quaternion algebra
fiber parametrization as great circles in S³
quaternion left and right group action
Fibonacci sphere sampling for uniform S² coverage
4D rotation in xy and zw planes
Seifert disk construction for linking number
palette: longitude rainbow: full HSV cycle around S² equator
motion: slow 4D rotation in xy and zw planes at different rates (0.2, 0.15)
quaternion left action: fibers swirl as base S² rotates
quaternion right action: rings spin in place within each fiber
great circle path through S³ (XW plane)
screw path combining left and right rotation at different speeds
projection pole movement: fibers flow through infinity dynamically
geometry: S²: 2-sphere, base space of the fibration
Hopf fibers: great circles in S³, each a preimage of a point on S²
Villarceau circles: projected fibers lying on nested tori in R³
nested tori: level sets of the fibration in R³
Seifert disk: 2-disk in S³ bounded by a fiber
linking number 1 between every pair of distinct fibers
avoid: generic torus knots presented without fiber bundle context
standard 3D Euler angle rotation (loses the S³ equivariance)
flat 2D projections that hide the 4D structure
real-time physics simulation (this is pure geometry)
